language_policy.description: The project's stance on technology neutrality (GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md principle 2). Not a human language: those are under `languages`.

languages.description: The human languages Guild uses in this project, chosen by the human at onboarding (GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 3.2). Not required by the schema so that state created before section 3.2 stays valid across a core upgrade; when it is missing, the DM asks for it at the triage of the next run instead of assuming one.

conversation.description: Language tag for every message a person reads in the exchange: questions, requests as presented, escalations, role announcements, summaries and results.

state_prose.description: Language tag for the human-readable prose inside .guild/state/ and its Markdown views.

git.description: Language tag for commit messages, pull request titles and descriptions, and review comments posted to the repository host.

pull_request_review_automation.description: Whether the Barbarian and/or the Rogue also run automatically on every pull request as a CI job on the repository host, chosen by the human at onboarding (GUILD_MASTER_SPEC.md section 11.4). The job only comments. Not required by the schema so that state created before section 11.4 stays valid across a core upgrade; when it is missing, the DM asks at the next triage.

profiles.description: Canonical ids of the profiles that run on every pull request; empty means no automation.

agent_client.description: The agent client the CI job runs, as chosen by the human.

ci_platform.description: The CI platform of the repository host that runs the job, e.g. github-actions.

mode.description: The job posts review comments only: it is never a gate result and never blocks a merge.
